findings.details: [P2] Preserve the originating fire's actual admission time while following continueAsNew only for terminal status. The observer follows chain.nextRunId and then overwrites fire.admittedAt/lagMs from the successor. Independent Engine run fired on time at12:00:30; completing the first run 90 seconds later created a successor and rewrote the original fire to admittedAt12:02:00, lag90000, and false Needs attention. A queued successor can also erase an already-known admission. Keep the original/root admission immutable after first admission and test admitted/queued successors. Repro /tmp/interlock-236-review-boundary.ts; log same prefix.

[P3] Finish affected documentation updates. README and agent-workflows still promise identical portable reimports are no-ops although included enabled schedules are deliberately disabled/reset. ui-patterns still describes navigation attention as run-only and sourced only from runs.attention, omitting independent lag/auto-pause items and schedule links. version-cleanup still exhaustively enumerates only formats 1-4. Rewrite these existing contracts to agree with the new schedule behavior and format 5, rather than leaving contradictory appended guidance.

[P2] Preserve format 5 in selected-set portable imports. combineBundles chooses only formats 1..4 even when copied workflow entries contain schedules. A real exported schedule bundle passes inspectImportDocument, so the GitHub preview marks it importable, but importSelection(target,[bundle]) fails 'Schedules require bundle formatVersion 5'. Direct importWorkflows of the same bundle succeeds. Include schedules in the combined format choice and merge/validate schedule entries for repeated workflow identities so selected bundles cannot silently lose configuration or evade conflicts. Test single and overlapping selected schedule bundles atomically. Repro /tmp/interlock-236-review-import.ts; log same prefix.

[P2] Preserve ScheduleAlerts pagination across live refreshes. The tick-dependent React key remounts the alerts component and resets its offset. Independent fresh UI reviewer exercised24 actual isolated alerts, clicked More to page 2, then started an unrelated fixture run through API; its SSE/tick returned the view to page 1 and removed Previous. Use stable component identity and pass refresh changes into the data effect without resetting page. Evidence .tasks/issue-236/ui-review-26628afe/pagination-confirmed.log and attention-page 2-900.png/attention-reset-900.png. I inspected the actual log and matching source; I did not execute this browser interaction.

[P3] Associate invalid IANA time-zone feedback with the zone control. All timing validation is collapsed to issues.timing and rendered only on Cron expression, so an invalid zone marks the valid expression invalid while its zone field has no associated error. Fresh UI reviewer confirmed actual invalid-zone interaction; evidence journeys-keyboard.log and invalid-zone-900.png in /tmp/interlock-236-ui-review/. Preserve nested issue paths and attach errors to their corresponding control.

[P2] Reset the JSON editor's raw buffer and validity together during conflict reload. onReload sets jsonValid true, but JsonEditor resets only when serialized input changes. With a concurrent name-only change, entered invalid JSON remains visible and marked invalid after Reload/discard edits, yet Save now succeeds and persists the earlier valid JSON. Independent fresh UI reviewer reproduced through actual controls and API peer update; evidence journeys-conflict-json.log/conflict-json-reload-900.png. I inspected the log and source. Explicitly reset/remount editor on reload or control raw text and validity as one state; test unchanged underlying JSON.

[P2] Close and discard the schedule editor after accepting navigation. Fresh independent UI reviewer used browser Back from a dirty schedule modal to the same workflow's Runs tab, then accepted Discard changes. URL/tab changed to Runs but the modal and saveable supposedly discarded draft remained open, blocking the destination. The schedule component remains mounted and its portal does not follow tab visibility. Clear editor/local draft after accepted route or selection changes while preserving Keep editing. Evidence journeys-route-delete.log and discard-left-editor-900.png; I inspected the actual journey log and matching source; full fresh report is /tmp/interlock-236-ui-review/ui-review.md.
